metadata.description: Agents and skills that run Android use cases through appium-mcp, find the issue in the logs and the code, fix it, adb push it and verify it. For Claude Code, VS Code (Copilot chat) and Copilot.

plugins.name: live-view-mcp
plugins.description: Connects appium-mcp (live-view-app → Tools → appium-mcp) and checks the setup with /check-setup: the device, Appium, and whether system push is possible. The device-safety rules every plugin follows.

plugins.name: usecase-runner
plugins.description: Runs a plain-text use case ("disable BT / launch pairing screen") on the device, recording logcat and the screen.

plugins.name: log-triage
plugins.description: Reads a run's logcat, crashes and ANRs: what failed, what kind of failure, and whose code it is.

plugins.name: code-fix
plugins.description: Finds the root cause in the source (file:line), proposes a fix and, after your approval, applies it.

plugins.name: build-push
plugins.description: Builds the changed module and, after your approval, adb pushes it to the device, restarts it and can roll back.

plugins.name: fix-loop
plugins.description: The whole loop: run the use case, triage, fix (Gate 1), build, push (Gate 2), verify, report.
